summary:
W5b's half of both open items is done and reproduces. Neither item closes until W2 lands its two handoffs, so the wave still does not pass.

done:5. With the CSS handed to W2 injected, I measured every one of the 48 splashes in the real client:
- 1920x1080: card p50 77-82, plate box 83-90, 0 of 48 under 70.
- 1280x720: card p50 71-78, plate box 78-88.
With the CSS actually shipped in screens.css, every card still fails:
- 1920x1080: card p50 50-59, plate box 59-71, 46 of 48 plates under 70.
- 1280x720: card p50 38-48.

hud:HUD-2. The chip art still passes (min pair 59.5, 0 of 120 pairs under 55). Portrait.tsx still knows only 'portrait' | 'splash', so the scoreboard, kill feed, ally frames, recap and banners all still draw portrait.png.

One minor regression from the refix: the card-floor toe lifts every splash's black point. p1 median goes from about 20 to 48 luma, up to 57, and p5-p95 contrast drops by a median of 30 levels (Ilsheta First Bell 106 -> 72). Seen full-size, the splashes read hazier, with a grey veil over the domes, trees and legs.

No blocker-class problem in anything I looked at.

items.evidence:
My own run of the real client: dev :5190, real Chrome GPU via pw.mjs, hmr off. The script is _harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver2_loading.mjs, run as `node _harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver2_loading.mjs _harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver2_loading_rects.json 1920x1080,1280x720`. It covers all 48 splashes in 5 RIFT loading fixtures, with the seat order offset by 3 from the refix script so each splash lands on a different seat. Every image was confirmed is-ok before the shot, and there were 0 console errors. Shots: _harness/_shots/fw_W5b_ver2_loading_{1920,1280}_r{0-4}_{now,prop}.png. Luma was computed with the reviewer's own _harness/_reports/final_menus_scripts/luma.cjs on each .pcard rect and its plate img rect (output: _harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver2_luma_loading.txt).

Shipped CSS ('now', screens.css:417-418 unchanged, the gate as it stands):
- 1920x1080: card p50 50 (ardit_base) to 59 (lisvel_gorgewalk), median 52.5; plate box p50 59 (marund_long_evening) to 71 (dunsom_highrim), median 64.5. 48 of 48 cards and 46 of 48 plates are under 70.
- 1280x720: card p50 38-48; plate box 48-59. All 48 fail.
The done criterion is 'plate p50 70-110', so it is not met in the shipped client.

Handoff CSS injected ('prop': 5 % top mask; meta scrim 0.90 / 0.62 / 0 with padding-top 2u):
- 1920x1080: card p50 77-82, median 80; plate 83-90. 0 of 48 under 70.
- 1280x720: card p50 71 (kemdo_highrim) to 78; plate 78-88. 0 under 70, but only 1 level of headroom.
Above 200, both modes: <= 0.8 % on every card except the seat-0 self card (4.0-4.1 % at 1920, 6.6-6.7 % at 1280). That is the white self outline, which is UI, not art.

This reproduces the refix's claims (now: card 50-58 / plate 59-71; prop: card 75-82 / plate 84-90) within 2 levels. The art changes are confined to the 48 splash PNGs (git show --stat e823fa10). Portraits are untouched, so draft cells keep their round-1 pass. plates.py is additive: top_s, floor_s and card_lo_q default to None, so W5a's callers are unaffected.

The item is still partly: the gate passes only with CSS that W2 has not landed (screens.css last touched by W2 in 5211268c / f1022c6e, no .pcard change).

Watch item for W2 when it lands: under the prop scrim the meta text sits on a lighter ground. 'Seat 10 / Lampglass' over Lisvel's bright ground is still legible but weaker (_harness/_shots/fw_W5b_ver2_card_foot_now_vs_prop.png, top = now, bottom = prop). The 5 % top fade also leaves a hard edge under the BOT-tag band (fw_W5b_ver2_loading_1920_r1_prop.png).
items.fixHint:
W5b has nothing left to do here. W2 lands the handoff in src/ui/styles/screens.css:
- .pcard__art > .aimg / .aimg__skel mask: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, rgba(0,0,0,.7) 2.5%, #000 5%).
- .pcard__meta: padding-top calc(2 * var(--u)); background linear-gradient(to top, rgba(11,13,17,.90) 0%, rgba(11,13,17,.62) 45%, rgba(11,13,17,0) 100%).
W2 should keep text contrast on the meta lines (a text-shadow on .pcard__name / .pcard__role is enough). Then re-run fw_W5b_ver2_loading.mjs --css now. The gate is card and plate p50 >= 70 on all 48 splashes at 1920x1080 and 1280x720.

items.evidence:
The art half still holds. `node _harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver1_fdist_all16.mjs` on the shipped art/out/fighters/*/icon.png (last changed in a72cf2e1) at 26 px with a circle mask: min pair ilsheta-ulkro 59.5, 0 of 120 pairs under 55, 1 of 16 chips with more than half its pixels above luma 150.

The usage half is unchanged. src/ui/components/Portrait.tsx:55-59 accepts only kind 'portrait' | 'splash' and resolves s.portrait / f.art.portrait. These HUD faces still render portrait.png:
- scoreboard: src/ui/hud/panels.tsx:110
- recap: panels.tsx:192, 209
- ally frames: side.tsx:59
- target: status.tsx:217
- banners and kill feed: top.tsx:194, 275, 284
Only minimap.tsx:176 draws icon.png. grep finds no 'chip' kind and no art.icon use anywhere in src/ui outside the minimap.

No W5b-owned file can route these faces to the chip. Replacing portrait.png would break the draft, Collection and loading screens. The wave note's assumption that 'Portrait.tsx needs no change' was wrong, because Portrait.tsx never read icon.png.
items.fixHint: W2 adds kind 'chip' to Portrait (it resolves f.art.icon, falling back to the portrait) and passes it at side.tsx:59, panels.tsx:110/192/209, top.tsx:194/275/284 and status.tsx:217 (dialbar.tsx:136 is optional, since it is a larger face). Then re-shoot the 1080 scoreboard and kill feed.

regressions: minor (art, W5b): the card-floor toe (plates.py card_floor, plates.json card_lo 0.31 at q 0.20) lifts every splash's black point and flattens its range. Whole-image luma over 48 splashes, old (e823fa10~1) vs new: p1 median +28 (new range 16-57), p5 median +27, p50 +6, p95 -2; p5-p95 contrast drops by a median of 30 levels and up to 42 (Ilsheta First Bell 106 -> 72, Ervet base 107 -> 78, Rishal Chalkline 101 -> 80); saturation in the darkest quarter drops by a median of 0.06; 0 % clipped (_harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver2_splash_diff.txt). Seen full-size, the splashes read hazier, with a grey veil over the domes, trees and legs (_harness/_shots/fw_W5b_ver2_splash_oldnew_a.png and fw_W5b_ver2_splash_oldnew_lisvel_gorgewalk.png, old above / left). Splashes are also shown in the draft showcase (draft.tsx:245-246), the lot (draft.tsx:405) and the shop offers (shop.tsx:205). In the draft showcase the change is mild, and the title and text stay legible (_harness/_shots/fw_W5b_ver2_sweep_1920_draft_locked.png vs fw_W5b_ver1_sweep_1920_draft_locked.png; the sweep_720 draft and skins run passed with 0 failures, _harness/_reports/fw_W5b_ver2_sweep.json). Suggested follow-up, not a reason to rebuild now: once W2's card CSS is in, re-measure with a lower card_lo or a smaller toe_left, and keep the full-splash p1 around 30 or below.
watch (W2 handoff, not W5b): under the prop CSS the meta text contrast is weaker over bright grounds, and at 1280x720 the lowest card has only 1 level of headroom (kemdo_highrim 71).
